meta.defaultDescription: RÈRA is the premium digital platform dedicated to discovering Pointe Denis: stays, accommodation, activities and experiences at the heart of Gabon.

hero.title: Discover Pointe Denis, differently.
hero.subtitle: A destination between ocean, nature, history and unique experiences at the heart of Gabon.

why.title: A peninsula between the Atlantic Ocean and equatorial forest
why.subtitle: Just minutes from Libreville by boat, Pointe Denis offers a rare concentration of authentic Gabon.

items.title: Wild beaches
items.text: Miles of fine sand bordered by the Atlantic Ocean, far from the city buzz.

items.title: Pristine nature
items.text: Equatorial forest, mangroves and local wildlife within reach.

history.title: In the footsteps of King Denis
history.subtitle: Pointe Denis takes its name from King Denis, an emblematic figure of the Mpongwè people and Gabon's history.

timeline.title: The reign of King Denis
timeline.text: King Denis (Antchouwé Kowe Rapontchombo) marked the history of the Gabon estuary through his political and trade influence.

timeline.title: A people, an identity
timeline.text: For generations, the Mpongwè people have shaped the cultural identity of the Gabon estuary, between oral tradition, fishing and craftsmanship.

timeline.title: A heritage to preserve
timeline.text: RÈRA is committed to promoting and passing on this living memory to visitors, with respect and accuracy.
